test_AttrDict_immutability: test the AttrDict class immutability feature to lock and unlock nested config dictionaries
test_merge_cfg_from_cfg: test merging one config object into another using merge_cfg_from_cfg with valid and invalid keys
test_merge_cfg_from_file: test loading and merging configuration values from a YAML file into the global cfg object
test_merge_cfg_from_list: test merging configuration key-value pairs from a flat list into the global cfg object
test_AttrDict_serialization: test serializing an AttrDict to YAML and back while preserving immutability state
